Chapter 6934: Burning Candle

Chapter 6934: Burning Candle

A grand immortal naturally wanted to struggle and defend himself. Alas, he was a fish on the chopping board.

“I’ll speak, I’ll speak!” He abandoned dignity and grace.

“It’s too late.” Li Qiye smiled.

“I can tell you their location!” He begged for forgiveness.

“I don’t need it since I can extract your mind.” Li Qiye smiled.

“No, I sealed them in an enclosed temporal box and gave it to my first brother, Treasure Immortal Lord!” He was scared out of his mind.

“Got it.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Please spare me.” He had enjoyed life too much to let it go now.

“It’s too late, I will still extract your mind.” Li Qiye said and tore him apart, exposing his true fate.

“Ahh!” He bellowed in agony.

Li Qiye directly obtained the information and sure enough, the guy was not lying regarding the gift.

Timeflow observed how effortlessly Li Qiye separated the mind from the true fate again. This time, the victim was an immortal.

“Ugh...” He couldn’t help but feel nauseous.

“Do you know why you’re still alive?” Li Qiye hadn’t killed Perpetual yet.

Unfortunately, the immortal couldn’t speak right now in his current state.

“Because I want you to live for a long time to be a perpetual candle for this world.” Li Qiye said before returning his mind to the true fate.

Next, Li Qiye molded the galaxy form into a burning candle.

“No...” He felt something burning both time and his new body.

This agony would take a long time, given his tenacity and vitality as an immortal. This endless suffering was far worse than death. He wanted to scream as if that would somehow lessen the pain. Unfortunately, he could no longer do so.

His flesh served as candle wax, turning into nourishment for the collapsed world. The light slowly chased away the darkness and fixed the temporal-spatio frameworks. Little life forms came next. Of course, later on, the new world had no idea of its origin.

Timeflow observed the mending of this world. He had seen deaths of immortals before but not something like this.

“Scared?” Li Qiye smiled.

“A little.” He nodded; his teeth chattered slightly.

“Yes, but this is warranted against those who have destroyed worlds and refined lives. Since immortals view others as food, they should become food as well.” Li Qiye said.

“That makes sense.” Timeflow said before raising his hand: “Immortal, I have never refined or devoured a world before, I swear this to you. I am a good overlord.”

Li Qiye smirked in response.

“Of course, I have destroyed some continents before, but not anything belonging to the dark path.” His voice became weaker.

“If I wanted to make a candle out of you, I would have done it long ago.” Li Qiye smiled.

He heaved a sigh of relief and sat butt-first on the ground. Perpetual’s terrible fate still frightened him.

“Come, we’ll go to a nice place.” Li Qiye said.

“A nice place?” He was surprised to hear this.

“Right, the notorious Breaker branch should be a nice place to light up some candles.” Li Qiye smiled.

“I, I can’t argue with that.” He got up again: “We’re going to find Breaker Immortal?”

“Just need to beat up the kids first, the adults will come out afterward.” Li Qiye smiled.
